Coram : T.S. THAKUR*, VIKRAMAJIT SEN
OR/SSA SERVICE OF ENGINEERS (VALIDATION OF APPOINTMENT) ACT, 2002: Nature and purpose of the Act - Held: The Act cannot be said to be a validating enactment - The enactment in the case B c at hand deals with the law relating to regularisation of incumbents holding. public office on ad hoc or the same way as regularisation of such 0 temporary appointments is ordered in terms of a scheme for that purpose - Legislation under challenge was not a Validation Act as it purported to be but an enactment that regularised the appointments of graduate Stipendiary Engineers working as ad hoc
Decision Date : 19-02-2014 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 8322/2009 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
